```{r setup, include=F, message=F}

library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

fn_files <- list.files(path = file.path("Utils"), full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(fn_files, source))

Rcpp::sourceCpp("SFS-master/src/sampleSFS.cpp")

```

```{r, include = F}

sub_cols <- c("C > A" = "#4FA9DF", "C > G" = "#231F20", "C > T" = "#E43B34",
              "T > A" = "#E0E0E0", "T > C" = "#8CC63F", "T > G" = "#EFA9CB")

bg_cols <- c("C > A" = "#D3E9F7", "C > G" = "#D9D9D9", "C > T" = "#F2C6C6",
             "T > A" = "#F7F7F7", "T > C" = "#E3EFD0", "T > G" = "#FAEBF3")

equal_breaks <- function(n = 3, s = 0.05, ...){
  function(x){
    d <- s * diff(range(x)) / (1 + 2 * s)
    seq(min(x) + d, max(x) - d, length = n)
  }
}

```

# Lung A. data

```{r}

obj_name <- load("LACA24.Rdata")

LACA <- as_tibble(get("V"))

V = as.matrix(LACA[, order(colSums(LACA))])

```

# Cosmic data

```{r}

COSMIC <- read_tsv("COSMIC_v3.2_SBS_GRCh37.tsv")

COSMIC_matrix <- COSMIC %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = colnames(COSMIC)[1])

X <- as.matrix(COSMIC_matrix)

```


# KL-NMF

## Model selection

```{r, warning = F, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 3, fig.align = "center"}

testk <- k.choice(trials = 5:15, seed = 1, V = V)

# testk$bicall

df <- data.frame(k = as.integer(names(testk$bicall)), bic = as.numeric(testk$bicall))

g0 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = k, y = bic)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "dodgerblue4") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = df[df$k == testk$k, ], size = 4, shape = 1, colour = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = df$k) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Number of signatures," ~ italic(k)),
    y = "Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

g0

# The model with the smallest BIC is indicated. 
```

## Fit

```{r}

k = 9

fit <- KLNMF(V, k = k, seed = 1:10, tol = 1e-8, maxiter = 1000)

```

## SFS

```{r, warning = F}

dev1 = sampleSFS(P = fit$W, E = fit$H, maxIter = 10^5, beta = 0.5, check = 1000)

prob.min = dev1$Pminimum
prob.max = dev1$Pmaximum

sig = rep(c(1:k), dev1$totalIter)
mut <- c("C > A","C > G","C > T","T > A","T > C","T > G")
sub = rep(mut, each = 16)

dat1 = data.frame(m = factor(rownames(LACA), levels = unique(rownames(LACA))), sub = sub, S = t(prob.min))
datmin = reshape(dat1, varying = colnames(dat1)[-c(1,2)], direction = "long", v.names = "min")

dat1 = data.frame(m = factor(rownames(LACA), levels = unique(rownames(LACA))), S = t(prob.max))
datmax = reshape(dat1, varying = colnames(dat1)[-1], direction = "long", v.names = "max")

data2 = merge(datmin, datmax, by = c("m", "time", "id"))
data2$time <- factor(data2$time)

data2$sub  <- factor(data2$sub, levels = names(sub_cols))
sig_levels <- levels(data2$time)


```

### Mutational signatures


```{r, warning = F, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, fig.align = "center"}

ylim_df <- data2 %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(max, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ytop  = ymax * 1.05,
         label = paste("Signature", time))

grid_df <- ylim_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(yb = list({
    rng <- c(-0.05 * ymax, 1.05 * ymax)
    equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2)(rng)
  })) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(yb) %>%
  ungroup()

panel_df <- expand.grid(sub  = factor(names(sub_cols), levels = names(sub_cols)),
                        time = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels))

label_df <- ylim_df %>%
  mutate(sub = factor("T > G", levels = names(sub_cols)),
         m   = levels(data2$m)[length(levels(data2$m))])

g1 <- ggplot(data2, aes(x = m, y = min)) +
  geom_rect(data = panel_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(fill = sub),
            xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bg_cols) +
  geom_hline(data = grid_df, aes(yintercept = yb),
             colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = m, y = max), stat = "identity", width = 0.78, fill = "dodgerblue4") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, fill = "grey70") +
  geom_text(data = label_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = m, y = ytop, label = label),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(time), cols = vars(sub),
             scales = "free", switch = "x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),   
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey75", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "line"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  ylab("Probability") + xlab("Mutation types") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     breaks = equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2),
                     expand = c(0.05, 0))
g1

ggsave(filename = "Output/signatures_NMF.pdf", plot = g1, width = 8, height = 6)

```


### Normalized Exposures

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3, fig.align = "center"}

## equivalent to signature plot
prob.min = dev1$Eminimum%*%diag(1/colSums(dev1$E_lastCheckResults[1:k,]))
prob.max = dev1$Emaximum%*%diag(1/colSums(dev1$E_lastCheckResults[1:k,]))
dat1 = data.frame(m = factor(colSums(V), levels=unique(colSums(V))), S = t(prob.min))
datmin = reshape(dat1, varying = colnames(dat1)[-1], direction = "long", v.names = "min")

datmax = reshape(dat1, varying = colnames(dat1)[-1], direction = "long", v.names = "max")

dat2 = merge(datmin,datmax, by = c("m","time","id"))
dat2$time = factor(dat2$time)

g2 = ggplot(dat2, aes(x = m, y = min)) +

# Min-Vol KL-NMF

## Regularization parameter $\lambda$

```{r}

lambda_tilde <- tuning_lambda(V, k, seed = 1:2, delta = 0.1)

# lambda_tilde$table

```


## Fit

```{r}

fit_min <- MINVOLNMF(V, k = k, seed = 1:10, tol = 1e-8, maxiter = 1000,  lambda_tilde = 0.005, delta = 0.1)

```


### Mutational signatures

```{r, warning = F, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, fig.align = "center"}

P <- fit_min$W
k <- ncol(P)

mut <- c("C > A","C > G","C > T","T > A","T > C","T > G")
sub = rep(mut, each = 16)

dat1 = data.frame(m = factor(rownames(LACA), levels = unique(rownames(LACA))), sub = sub, S = P)
data2 = reshape(dat1, varying = colnames(dat1)[-c(1,2)], direction = "long", v.names = "max")
data2$time <- factor(data2$time)

data2$sub  <- factor(data2$sub, levels = names(sub_cols))
sig_levels <- levels(data2$time)

ylim_df <- data2 %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(max, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ytop  = ymax * 1.05,
         label = paste("Signature", time))

grid_df <- ylim_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(yb = list({
    rng <- c(-0.05 * ymax, 1.05 * ymax)
    equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2)(rng)
  })) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(yb) %>%
  ungroup()

panel_df <- expand.grid(sub  = factor(names(sub_cols), levels = names(sub_cols)),
                        time = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels))

label_df <- ylim_df %>%
  mutate(sub = factor("T > G", levels = names(sub_cols)),
         m   = levels(data2$m)[length(levels(data2$m))])

g1 <- ggplot(data2, aes(x = m, y = max)) +
  geom_rect(data = panel_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(fill = sub),
            xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bg_cols) +
  geom_hline(data = grid_df, aes(yintercept = yb),
             colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, fill = "dodgerblue4") +
  geom_text(data = label_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = m, y = ytop, label = label),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(time), cols = vars(sub),
             scales = "free", switch = "x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey75", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "line"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  ylab("Probability") + xlab("Mutation types") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     breaks = equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2),
                     expand = c(0.05, 0))
g1

```{r}
# 1. Vælg de COSMIC-signaturer du vil plotte
valgte_sigs <- c("SBS3", "SBS40", "SBS39", "SBS4") # Ret til dine ønskede signaturer
P_cosmic <- X[, valgte_sigs, drop = FALSE]

# 2. Sikr at rækkefølgen på rækkerne matcher dine mutationstyper (16 af hver i rækkefølge)
# Udtrækker f.eks. "C>A" fra "A[C>A]A" og laver mellemrum ("C > A") så det matcher din kode
raw_sub <- gsub(".*\\[(.*)\\].*", "\\1", rownames(P_cosmic))
formatted_sub <- gsub(">", " > ", raw_sub)

# Sorter data så det følger rækkefølgen i names(sub_cols) (C > A, C > G, osv.)
ord <- order(factor(formatted_sub, levels = names(sub_cols)), rownames(P_cosmic))
P_cosmic <- P_cosmic[ord, , drop = FALSE]
formatted_sub <- formatted_sub[ord]

# 3. Klargør data til ggplot (bevarer de rigtige SBS-navne)
data2 <- as.data.frame(P_cosmic) %>%
  mutate(
    m = factor(rownames(P_cosmic), levels = unique(rownames(P_cosmic))),
    sub = factor(formatted_sub, levels = names(sub_cols))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(valgte_sigs),
    names_to = "sig",
    values_to = "max"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = valgte_sigs))

# 4. Hjælpe-dataframes til y-aksen, gitterlinjer, baggrund og labels
ylim_df <- data2 %>%
  group_by(sig) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(max, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    ytop  = ymax * 1.05,
    label = as.character(sig) # Viser nu "SBS1", "SBS2" osv. i stedet for "Signature 1"
  )

grid_df <- ylim_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(yb = list({
    rng <- c(-0.05 * ymax, 1.05 * ymax)
    equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2)(rng)
  })) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(yb) %>%
  ungroup()

panel_df <- expand.grid(
  sub = factor(names(sub_cols), levels = names(sub_cols)),
  sig = factor(valgte_sigs, levels = valgte_sigs)
)

label_df <- ylim_df %>%
  mutate(
    sub = factor("T > G", levels = names(sub_cols)),
    m   = levels(data2$m)[length(levels(data2$m))]
  )

# 5. Plot
g_cosmic <- ggplot(data2, aes(x = m, y = max)) +
  geom_rect(data = panel_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(fill = sub),
            xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bg_cols) +
  geom_hline(data = grid_df, aes(yintercept = yb),
             colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, fill = "dodgerblue4") +
  geom_text(data = label_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = m, y = ytop, label = label),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(sig), cols = vars(sub),
             scales = "free", switch = "x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey75", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "line"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  ylab("Probability") + xlab("Mutation types") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     breaks = equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2),
                     expand = c(0.05, 0))

g_cosmic
```



# Match with signatures from COSMIS
```{r}

W <- fit$W
x <- X[,4]
w <- W[,2]

cosine(x,w)

test <- signature.match(X,W)

test
